title: What's the Best Month for Getting Hired
paragraphs: Many people believe that January is the best time to look for a new job. But a new study suggests that the best results may actually come in the fall.

The study was carried out by Huntr, a company that makes tools to help people manage their job search. It looked at almost 2 million job applications made by about 41,000 users between October 2024 and June 2026.

The results showed that October was the strongest month in 2025. In October, about 32.4% of job seekers got at least one interview. October also had the highest interview rate per application, at 5.1%. November and September came next, at 4.2% and 3.9%.

In contrast, January was the weakest month for interviews per application, with a rate of only 2.7%. This may surprise many people. Sam Wright, Huntr's head of career strategy, said that everyone thinks January is the best month, and many people stop looking for work in November because of the holidays.

The study also found that job search activity is highest in September. In all three years the company looked at, September was the busiest month. Activity was lowest in December, when many people take a break.

However, Wright said that December is "the most misunderstood month" in the job search. Because fewer people apply for jobs at that time, there may be less competition. December's interview rate, at 3.6%, was actually slightly above the yearly average of 3.5%.

The day of the week also seems to matter. Applications sent on Tuesdays had the highest interview rate, at 3.9%, followed closely by Wednesdays and Thursdays. Applications sent on weekends did much worse. Wright's advice is simple: send applications from Tuesday to Thursday.
It is important to remember, though, that the best time to apply may also depend on a person's industry.
